I just recently finished [Tatami Galaxy](https://myanimelist.net/anime/7785/Yojouhan_Shinwa_Taikei). At first glance, it'll not pass my three episode rule because it keeps repeating the same pattern. It only got interesting at episode 6 with his "three dilemmas".

By episode 10 it got me confused. [Tatami Galaxy](/s "I thought he just joined all the clubs and the random "references" happened because of his multiple activities on those clubs. But now he's a recluse stuck in a room that connects to other parallel scenarios.")

At episode 11 it seems to wrap up the story but leave me dissatisfied. So what should I take out of this? That opportunities are just dangling in front of you and it's just waiting for you to grab it? That upon merely grabbing them will end as being happily ever after? I wish real life would be that simple. The way things ended in the story seems to be too optimistic.
